question: Which among the following alloys is a combination of gold and silver?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Electrum**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Electrum** is a naturally occurring** alloy of gold and silver**, with trace amounts of other metals.
 
• A naturally occurring alloy of silver and gold, electrum also contains trace amounts of copper and other metals.
 
• Depending on the ratio of gold to silver, the color can range from light yellow to brill
